data.command: What security tools do you have deployed?

data.text:
Let me check the system config for you. I've got a few security tools running on this Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS system with kernel 5.15.0-91.

We're running Nginx 1.24.0 as our web server, which has a basic WAF (Web Application Firewall) enabled, filtering out common SQLi and XSS attacks on port 80 and 443. I've also configured it to run on HTTPS with a self-signed certificate, so all traffic is encrypted.

On the firewall front, I've got UFW (Uncomplicated Firewall) set up to block incoming traffic on all ports but 22 (SSH), 80, and 443. I've also set up a custom rule to block all incoming traffic from known malicious IP addresses.

For monitoring, I've got Prometheus 2.38.2 set up to collect metrics from the server, and Grafana 9.5.3 is running to visualize the data. I've also got a basic ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) stack set up to collect and analyze log data. Elasticsearch 8.5.6 is running on port 9200, Logstash 8.5.6 on port
